description_en: Removes virus scan blacklists and whitelists entries in batch by entry IDs. The entire removal operation is failed if any of the specified entry IDs do not belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 按名单条目ID批量移除病毒扫描黑白名单条目。存在不属于当前阿里云账号的名单条目ID时整体移除失败
name: RemoveVirusScanAdditionalLists

parameters.help_en: The collection of entry IDs to remove. At least one entry ID must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 待移除的名单条目ID集合，至少包含1个
parameters.name: list_ids
